  SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT deptno) AS deptno_array
  FROM emp
  WHERE empno < 20
)

  emp.empno,

    WHEN emp.deptno IS NULL THEN NULL

  END AS d
FROM emp
CROSS JOIN sub
